title: FireDecision
description: Outcome of the fire gate for an armed watchlist trigger: whether to proceed with the entry and at what size multiplier. Returned by the fire-decision step toward the trigger-strategy workflow.

proceed.description: True to proceed with the entry; false to hold (the trigger stays armed for later evaluation).

size_multiplier.description: Position-size multiplier applied to the base allocation for this fire. 0 suppresses the entry without disarming.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the fire decision (audit).
